name: Brute Force Investigation

detection_logic.single_source:
(
| tstats summariesonly=true count as attempts
  from datamodel=Authentication.Authentication
  where earliest=-15m latest=now Authentication.action IN ("failure","success")
  by _time span=5m Authentication.src Authentication.user Authentication.action
)
| append [
  search index=wineventlog earliest=-15m latest=now (EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=4624)
  | eval Authentication.src=coalesce(IpAddress,Source_Network_Address)
  | eval Authentication.user=TargetUserName
  | eval Authentication.action=if(EventCode=4625,"failure","success")
  | eval attempts=1
]
| eval attempts=coalesce(attempts,1)
| eval src=coalesce(Authentication.src)
| eval user=coalesce(Authentication.user)
| stats sum(eval(Authentication.action="failure")*attempts) as fails
        sum(eval(Authentication.action="success")*attempts) as success
        dc(user) as unique_users
        by src _time
| eventstats perc95(fails) as p95_fails by src
| streamstats window=20 sum(fails) as rolling_fails by src
| eventstats avg(fails) as baseline by src
| where fails > p95_fails AND fails > 10 AND rolling_fails > 30 AND fails > baseline*3
| lookup identity_lookup user OUTPUT is_privileged
| lookup asset_inventory src OUTPUT criticality
| eval criticality=coalesce(criticality,1)
| eval risk_score=(fails*2)+(unique_users*5)+if(success>0,20,0)+if(is_privileged="true",30,0)
| eval risk_score=min(risk_score*criticality,100)
| eval confidence=case(risk_score>80,"high",risk_score>40,"medium",1=1,"low")
| eval escalate=if(risk_score>80 OR (success>0 AND unique_users>5),"true","false")
detection_logic.distributed_spray:
(index=wineventlog OR index=o365 OR index=azuread) earliest=-15m latest=now
(EventCode=4625 OR OperationName="UserLoginFailed")
| eval src=coalesce(src, IpAddress, Source_Network_Address, ClientIP)
| lookup ip_reputation src OUTPUT asn
| eval asn=coalesce(asn,"unknown")
| eval user=coalesce(user, TargetUserName, UserId)
| bin _time span=5m
| stats count as fails dc(src) as unique_src values(asn) as asns by user _time
| eventstats avg(unique_src) as baseline_src by user
| eval baseline_src=if(baseline_src<2,2,baseline_src)
| where unique_src > baseline_src*3 AND fails > 10 AND NOT match(mvjoin(asns,","),"trusted_corp_asn")
| lookup identity_lookup user OUTPUT is_privileged
| lookup asset_inventory user OUTPUT criticality
| eval criticality=coalesce(criticality,1)
| eval risk_score=(fails*2)+(unique_src*4)+if(is_privileged="true",30,0)
| eval risk_score=min(risk_score*criticality,100)
| eval confidence=case(risk_score>80,"high",risk_score>40,"medium",1=1,"low")
| eval escalate=if(risk_score>80,"true","false")
detection_logic.cross_source_correlation:
(index=wineventlog OR index=sysmon OR index=network) earliest=-30m latest=now
| eval src=coalesce(src, IpAddress)
| eval user=coalesce(user, TargetUserName, User)
| eval action=case(EventCode=4625,"failure",EventCode=4624,"success",EventCode=1,"process",1=1,"network")
| sort user src _time
| streamstats last(action) as prev_action by user src
| where prev_action="failure" AND action="success"
| stats values(action) as actions values(process_name) as processes values(dest_ip) as dest_ips min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by user src
| where "success" IN actions AND mvcount(processes)>0 AND (last_seen-first_seen)<600

correlation: Temporal sequence: authentication failure followed by success, with optional execution or network activity.
false_positive_logic:
| lookup known_admin_activity src OUTPUT allowed
| where isnull(allowed)
chain_context: Successful brute force yields valid credentials, enabling execution under legitimate account context, progressing to lateral movement.

name: Command Execution Investigation

detection_logic.execution_network_correlation:
index=sysmon earliest=-15m latest=now EventCode=1
| eval process=CommandLine
| eval parent=ParentImage
| eval user=User
| eval dest=Computer
| eval cmd_len=len(process)
| eval entropy=len(replace(process,"[A-Za-z0-9]",""))
| where like(process,"%powershell%")
   OR like(process,"%rundll32%")
   OR like(process,"%mshta%")
| where like(process,"%-enc%")
   OR like(process,"%FromBase64String%")
   OR like(process,"%IEX%")
   OR cmd_len > 200
   OR entropy > 50
| lookup admin_tools process OUTPUT process as allowed
| where isnull(allowed)
| lookup lolbin_parents parent OUTPUT risk_level
| lookup identity_lookup user OUTPUT is_privileged
| lookup asset_inventory dest OUTPUT criticality
| eval criticality=coalesce(criticality,1)
| stats values(process) as processes values(parent) as parents by user dest
| join dest [
    search index=network earliest=-15m latest=now
    | stats values(dest_ip) as connections by dest
]
| eval risk_score=20+if(risk_level="high",30,0)+if(is_privileged="true",30,0)+if(entropy>80,20,0)
| eval risk_score=min(risk_score*criticality,100)
| eval confidence=case(risk_score>80,"high",risk_score>40,"medium",1=1,"low")
| eval escalate=if(risk_score>80,"true","false")

correlation: Suspicious interpreter execution with obfuscation signals and optional network connections.
false_positive_logic:
| lookup known_admin_activity user OUTPUT allowed
| where isnull(allowed)
chain_context: Suspicious command execution can stage tooling or establish command-and-control, creating a path toward lateral movement.

name: Remote Services Investigation

detection_logic.sequence_volume_hybrid:
(index=wineventlog OR index=sysmon OR index=network) earliest=-20m latest=now
| eval src=coalesce(src, IpAddress)
| eval user=coalesce(user, TargetUserName, User)
| eval dest=coalesce(dest, Computer)
| eval action=case(EventCode=4624,"success",EventCode=1,"process",1=1,"network")
| sort user src _time
| streamstats last(action) as prev_action by user src
| stats values(action) as actions values(dest) as dests values(dest_ip) as dest_ips values(process_name) as processes dc(dest) as unique_dests by user src
| where ("success" IN actions AND mvcount(processes)>0 AND mvcount(dest_ips)>0)
   OR unique_dests > 5
| lookup identity_lookup user OUTPUT is_privileged
| lookup asset_inventory src OUTPUT criticality
| eval criticality=coalesce(criticality,1)
| eval risk_score=(unique_dests*10)+if(is_privileged="true",30,0)
| eval risk_score=min(risk_score*criticality,100)
| eval confidence=case(risk_score>80,"high",risk_score>40,"medium",1=1,"low")
| eval escalate=if(risk_score>80 OR unique_dests>5,"true","false")

correlation: Successful authentication followed by process/network activity or high-volume multi-destination access.
false_positive_logic:
| lookup known_admin_activity src OUTPUT allowed
| where isnull(allowed)
chain_context: Valid account access enables remote service use, which can lead to execution on additional hosts.

name: Credential Dumping Investigation

detection_logic.lsass_access:
index=sysmon earliest=-15m latest=now EventCode=10
| where TargetImage="*lsass.exe"
| where GrantedAccess IN ("0x1010","0x1410")
| eval user=User
| eval dest=Computer
| lookup identity_lookup user OUTPUT is_privileged
| lookup asset_inventory dest OUTPUT criticality
| eval criticality=coalesce(criticality,1)
| eval risk_score=60+if(is_privileged="true",30,0)
| eval risk_score=min(risk_score*criticality,100)
| eval escalate="true"
detection_logic.credential_tool_execution:
index=sysmon earliest=-15m latest=now EventCode=1
| eval process=CommandLine
| where like(process,"%procdump%")
   OR like(process,"%comsvcs%")
   OR like(process,"%mimikatz%")
   OR like(process,"%MiniDumpWriteDump%")
| eval user=User
| eval dest=Computer
| lookup identity_lookup user OUTPUT is_privileged
| lookup asset_inventory dest OUTPUT criticality
| eval criticality=coalesce(criticality,1)
| eval risk_score=70+if(is_privileged="true",30,0)
| eval risk_score=min(risk_score*criticality,100)
| eval escalate="true"

correlation: Credential dumping via LSASS access or credential dumping tool execution.
false_positive_logic:
| lookup known_admin_activity user OUTPUT allowed
| where isnull(allowed)
triage: LSASS accessed or dump tool used
chain_context: Credential dumping can expose reusable secrets, enabling privilege escalation and lateral movement.
